text:
alex.k: Heads-up — ACME returned the security questionnaire with a few hard requirements: per-tenant KMS keys, 7y audit log retention, and RBAC changes to prevent product engineers from viewing customer plaintext. They want proof artifacts and a walkthrough. Call tomorrow 11am PT. Can we list what to show?

maria.s: Thanks. Minimal show-and-tell: KMS envelope flow diagram, key provenance + rotation policy, IAM roles for key usage, audit log export pipeline (to customer S3 with SSE-KMS + object lock), retention proof, and RBAC matrix with examples. I can pull diagrams. :+1:

sam.r: Quick note — Hosted currently supports customer-managed keys (BYOK) when the customer can provide an external KMS in their cloud account, but we don't create isolated CMKs per tenant in Hosted today. Dedicated/Private can. Need to confirm what ACME expects exactly.

alex.k: They marked "per-tenant keys" as mandatory in Q5. @psm_tony will be on the call to negotiate if Dedicated is required.

psm_tony: I'll be there. We can offer BYOK for Hosted (customer-managed key in their account) or propose Dedicated as the default for per-tenant key custody. I'll push for acceptance of BYOK if possible.

eve.p: For audit logs: we can export structured request logs (metadata + redacted payload) to a customer-owned S3 bucket with SSE-KMS and Object Lock governance mode. Pipeline is kinesis -> lambda -> s3 or direct s3 ingest from our log shipper. I'll prepare a sanitized pipeline diagram and sample manifest.

sam.r: @maria.s can you draft a minimal RBAC policy snippet restricting decryption? Example snippet: 
```
roles:
  - name: secrets_admin
    permissions: [kms:Decrypt, logs:view_redacted]
  - name: product_engineer
    permissions: [deploy:create, model:read]
```
That should show separation of duties.

maria.s: On it. Also include CloudTrail mapping showing KMS Decrypt events are logged with principal id and key id — we can provide an anonymized example.

oncall-bot: Reminder: security-review call with ACME scheduled at 2026-04-12 18:00 UTC (tomorrow). Conference: https://meet.example.com/acme-sec-review 

alex.k: Good. They also requested pre-call artifacts. Proposed pack: 1) KMS architecture diagram, 2) sanitized CloudTrail decrypt sample, 3) audit export playbook (how logs are shipped & verification), 4) RBAC policy diff, 5) mapping to SOC2 control families. Who owns each?

maria.s: I'll do 1, 3, and 4. I'll store drafts in the eng-security drive and link.

sam.r: I can produce 2 (sanitized CloudTrail) — will strip ARNs, IPs, tokens and keep keyId + principal + timestamp. Expect a snippet in the thread by EOD.

eve.p: I'll map control evidence for 5, but need the compliance template. @oncall-bot can you paste the compliance repo link?

oncall-bot: compliance repo: https://repos.internal/redwood/compliance/soc2 

alex.k: Also prepare a 2-slide FAQ for the call: "we don't store customer plaintext", "key rotation process", "how we prove deletion/retention" — keep answers short.

psm_tony: I'll also ask ACME if they'd accept BYOK or if they truly require isolated CMKs per tenant. If they insist on isolated keys and refuse Dedicated, we need to scope engineering work and timeline.

maria.s: FYI: audit export proof will include a sample of S3 lifecycle + Object Lock config and a short snippet showing immutability settings.

sam.r: For the CloudTrail sample I'll include this sanitized line: 
`{"eventName":"Decrypt","awsRegion":"us-west-2","requestParameters":{"keyId":"arn:aws:kms:REDACTED:key/XXXX"},"userIdentity":{"arn":"arn:aws:iam::REDACTED:user/PRINCIPAL"}}`
(all IDs replaced).

eve.p: I'll prepare the SOC2 mapping doc and flag any gaps as "mitigations". If compliance needs to sign an attestation for key custody, I'll loop them in.

alex.k: Action list recap: maria — KMS diagram + RBAC diff + audit playbook; sam — sanitized CloudTrail; eve — SOC2 mapping + evidence links; psm_tony — client negotiation. Dry run 10:30 PT tomorrow before the call.

maria.s: I'll drop a drive link by 09:00 PT and ping for quick review. :rocket:

sam.r: Will upload the sanitized log snippet in ~3 hours.

eve.p: Looping compliance now.

alex.k: Thanks everyone. Keep messages short; we'll iterate tomorrow morning. :thumbsup:
